mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tbl_file_transfer_log (ft_dv_id, ft_serial_number, ft_file_kind, ft_ref_type, ft_ref_id, ft_file_name, ft_target_date, ft_status) SELECT S.sc_dv_id, S.sc_serial_number, 'CALL_AUDIO', 'sip_call', S.sc_id, S.sc_audio_path, DATE(S.sc_start_date), 'PENDING' FROM tbl_sip_call S WHERE S.sc_audio_path IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(S.sc_audio_path) <> '' AND S.sc_audio_path <> 'null' AND S.sc_start_date IS NOT NULL AND S.sc_start_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{ymd}, '%Y%m%d') AND S.sc_start_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{ymd}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_file_transfer_log SET ft_status = 'LOST', ft_last_error_code = COALESCE(ft_last_error_code, 'RETRY_DEADLINE') WHERE ft_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND ft_target_date < #{cutoff}

UPDATE tbl_file_transfer_log SET ft_status = 'VERIFIED', ft_attempt_count = ft_attempt_count + #{attempts}, ft_last_error_code = NULL, ft_device_bytes = COALESCE(#{deviceBytes,jdbcType=BIGINT}, ft_device_bytes), ft_server_bytes = #{serverBytes,jdbcType=BIGINT}, ft_first_attempt_at = CASE WHEN #{attempts} > 0 THEN COALESCE(ft_first_attempt_at, NOW()) ELSE ft_first_attempt_at END, ft_last_attempt_at = CASE WHEN #{attempts} > 0 THEN NOW() ELSE ft_last_attempt_at END, ft_verified_at = NOW() WHERE ft_id = #{ftId} AND ft_status <> 'DELETED_EVENT'

UPDATE tbl_file_transfer_log SET ft_status = 'FAILED', ft_attempt_count = ft_attempt_count + #{attempts}, ft_last_error_code = #{errorCode}, ft_device_bytes = COALESCE(#{deviceBytes,jdbcType=BIGINT}, ft_device_bytes), ft_first_attempt_at = COALESCE(ft_first_attempt_at, NOW()), ft_last_attempt_at = NOW() WHERE ft_id = #{ftId} AND ft_status <> 'DELETED_EVENT'

UPDATE tbl_file_transfer_log SET ft_status = 'MISSING', ft_attempt_count = ft_attempt_count + #{attempts}, ft_last_error_code = 'NO_FILE', ft_first_attempt_at = COALESCE(ft_first_attempt_at, NOW()), ft_last_attempt_at = NOW() WHERE ft_id = #{ftId} AND ft_status <> 'DELETED_EVENT'
mapper.select: SELECT ft_id, ft_file_kind, ft_file_name, ft_status, ft_attempt_count, ft_device_bytes, ft_last_error_code FROM tbl_file_transfer_log WHERE ft_ref_type = 'event' AND ft_ref_id = #{evId} ORDER BY ft_id

SELECT A.ev_id, A.ev_dv_id, A.ev_serial_number, A.ev_date, A.ev_is_deleted, A.ev_img_path, A.ev_img_path2, A.ev_mov_path, D.dv_ip FROM tbl_event_data A LEFT JOIN tbl_device D ON D.dv_id = A.ev_dv_id WHERE A.ev_id = #{evId}
SELECT ft_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tbl_file_transfer_log GROUP BY ft_status
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_event_data E SET E.ev_has_img = 1 WHERE E.ev_id = #{evId} AND E.ev_has_img = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_file_transfer_log F WHERE F.ft_ref_type = 'event' AND F.ft_ref_id = E.ev_id AND F.ft_file_kind = 'EVENT_IMAGE1' AND F.ft_status = 'VERIFIED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_file_transfer_log F2 WHERE F2.ft_ref_type = 'event' AND F2.ft_ref_id = E.ev_id AND F2.ft_file_kind IN ('EVENT_IMAGE1', 'EVENT_IMAGE2') AND F2.ft_status <> 'VERIFIED')

UPDATE tbl_event_data E SET E.ev_has_mov = 1 WHERE E.ev_id = #{evId} AND E.ev_has_mov = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_file_transfer_log F WHERE F.ft_ref_type = 'event' AND F.ft_ref_id = E.ev_id AND F.ft_file_kind = 'EVENT_VIDEO' AND F.ft_status = 'VERIFIED')
UPDATE tbl_sip_call SET sc_has_audio = 1 WHERE sc_id = #{scId} AND sc_has_audio = 0

UPDATE tbl_file_transfer_log SET ft_status_before_delete = ft_status, ft_status = 'DELETED_EVENT', ft_deleted_ev_id = ft_ref_id, ft_deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, ft_deleted_at = NOW(), ft_deleted_orig_path = #{origPath} WHERE ft_id = #{ftId} AND ft_status <> 'DELETED_EVENT'
